title: Performance orchestration, persistence, and recovery
boundary_reason: Owns admission, lifecycle orchestration, immutable private evidence, terminal publication, recovery, FlowState v4, and service composition.
behavioral_concerns: Disabled admission must be side-effect free; enabled admission must reject invalid policy, targets, execution prerequisites, cleanliness, isolation, samples, or budgets before unsafe work.
Exactly one terminal result must win across cancellation, timeout, stale writers, cleanup uncertainty, persistence failure, drift, and restart.
Flow-state versions 1 through 3 must remain readable; v4 performance pointers must validate and survive unrelated saves.
Private records must be contained, immutable, digest-bound, strictly decoded, and writer-fenced before publication.
Recovery must start no runtime or process and may only republish already valid immutable evidence.
Resume must retain immutable identities, counters, limits, and the absolute deadline and continue only from proven boundaries.

evidence.summary: The performance summary counts outcomes without gate filtering, while flow validation bounds those outcomes by required-target count rather than total target count [qa-v1-block-68cfca988b5aef1e551fa430, qa-v1-block-2fa5eb620169346ab567a9ec].

theories.claim: A valid performance run containing a met report-only target can fail flow-state publication because the summary counts met and missed comparisons across all targets, while validation limits their sum to required targets only.
theories.basis: The summary increments Required only for required targets but increments Met and Missed for every comparison; validation rejects Met+Missed greater than Required [qa-v1-block-68cfca988b5aef1e551fa430, qa-v1-block-2fa5eb620169346ab567a9ec]. Report-only targets are valid contract inputs [qa-v1-block-ce45392d2ebc036986b89d13].
theories.confirmation_condition: A summary with zero required targets, one report target, and one met comparison has Met=1 and Required=0, causing validatePerformanceFlowSummary to return invalid performance counts.
theories.refutation_condition: The complete implementation excludes report-target comparisons from Met and Missed, or validation permits comparison counts up to Required+Reports before publication.
theories.inconclusive_condition: An omitted caller transforms the target or comparison collections so report-only comparisons cannot reach performanceFlowSummary.
theories.safe_evidence_strategy: Exercise performanceFlowSummary and validatePerformanceFlowSummary with one report-only target and a met comparison using an isolated unit-test fixture without starting runtime or process work.
